title: System biology-based assessment of the molecular mechanism of epigallocatechin gallate in Parkinson's disease: via network pharmacology, in-silico evaluation & in-vitro studies.
authors: Fanai, Hannah Lalengzuali; Chand, Jagdish; Ahmad, Sheikh F; Attia, Sabry M; Emran, Talha Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学、分子对接和MD研究EGCG在帕金森病中的多靶点机制，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接与MD，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) compound (IMPHY000226) has the potential to modulate multiple molecular mechanisms involved in Parkinson's disease. Multiple targets such as SIRT3, FOXO1, PRKAA1, PPARGC1A, and CREBBP directly regulate reactive oxygen species levels and oxidative stress, suggesting that targeting these genes could help prevent further cellular damage. EGCG targets were identified using Swiss target prediction, revealing 31 targets modulated by EGCG. Specific keywords were used to identify 4663 targets related to PD modulation. The network was constructed and analyzed using the node and edge counts. Clustering analysis identified specific target groups with high edge counts and Kappa scores, indicating potential key players in PD modulation. The targets SIRT3, FOXO1, and PPARGC1A were predicted to have the highest binding energies via dual algorithm-based molecular docking studies. The MD simulation studies were performed for the highest-docked targets, SIRT3, FOXO1, and PPARGC1A, to assess the stability and interactions. The cell viability assays were conducted at various dosage concentrations for EGCG and resveratrol, which provided dose-dependent effects on cell survival. In the toxicity-induced group, the highest % cell viability of 94% and 81% was observed at a dosage of 6.25 microg/mL and 12.5 microg/mL. The toxicity-induced gene expression studies indicated that the EGCG upregulated the targets SOD2, FOXO1, and GPx. EGCG and resveratrol upregulated the targets SOD2, FOXO1, and GPx at a dosage concentration of 12.5 microg/mL. EGCG was found to be more potent than the resveratrol molecule, indicating that EGCG can be used as an anti-Parkinson agent.
abstract_zh: 表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯（EGCG）化合物（IMPHY000226）具有调节帕金森病中多种分子机制的潜力。多个靶点，如SIRT3、FOXO1、PRKAA1、PPARGC1A和CREBBP，直接调控活性氧水平和氧化应激，表明靶向这些基因可能有助于防止进一步的细胞损伤。使用Swiss target prediction鉴定了EGCG的靶点，揭示EGCG调节31个靶点。使用特定关键词识别了4663个与PD调节相关的靶点。通过节点和边数构建并分析了网络。聚类分析识别出具有高边数和Kappa评分的特定靶点组，表明它们在PD调节中可能是关键参与者。通过基于双算法的分子对接研究，预测靶点SIRT3、FOXO1和PPARGC1A具有最高的结合能。对对接得分最高的靶点SIRT3、FOXO1和PPARGC1A进行了MD模拟研究，以评估其稳定性和相互作用。在不同剂量浓度下对EGCG和resveratrol进行了细胞活力测定，结果显示其对细胞存活具有剂量依赖性效应。在毒性诱导组中，在6.25微克/毫升和12.5微克/毫升剂量下观察到最高细胞活力百分比分别为94%和81%。毒性诱导的基因表达研究表明，EGCG上调了靶点SOD2、FOXO1和GPx。EGCG和resveratrol在12.5微克/毫升剂量浓度下上调了靶点SOD2、FOXO1和GPx。发现EGCG比resveratrol分子更有效，表明EGCG可用作抗帕金森病药物。
